name: SPCA Selangor
legalName: Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (Persatuan Pencegahan Penganiayaan Haiwan)
summary: Prevent cruelty to animals in Selangor through sheltering and rehoming, neutering, inspection of cruelty cases and public education.
programmes: Spay and neuter (incl. Stray Free Selangor)
impact: Over 4,300 animals neutered in 2024 (4,340 in stats table; 4,387 in chairman's message)
1,183 neutered under Stray Free Selangor in 2024
beneficiaries: Stray and abused cats and dogs in the Klang Valley; pet owners and the public
